爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD045 望月利世Mochizuki Rize-你的镜头
“今晚我会是你镜头里最耀眼的Lady吗？”她问。
你不语，看着相机屏幕那充满爱意的双眼，你知道她在看着谁，因为站在这里的只有你。
她看你不说话，开启了撒娇模式，“是不是嘛，对不对嘛，亲爱的告诉我吧~”
你不自觉的露出了笑意，回答她：“是的，我的女士，你一直是我镜头下最耀眼的存在。”
胸型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD045 Mochizuki Rize-Your Lens
"Will I be the most dazzling lady in your lens tonight?" she asked.
You remain silent, looking at the loving eyes on the camera screen. You know who she's looking at, because you're the only one standing here.
Seeing your silence, she switches to her coquettish mode, "Will I? Right? Tell me, darling~" You unconsciously smile and answer, "Yes, my lady, you've always been the most dazzling presence in my lens."
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
